none: PAS CAM-E2F937: Roman Coin : Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantius II. Mint is uncertain, AD355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse shows bust right. Obverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows soldier stabbing fallen horseman. Reverse legend reads [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Die axis is uncertain, weight is 0.88g, diameter is 12.21mm
